title: OSS Remediation Recommendation
description: A Sonatype Guide remediation recommendation — the safest upgrade path from a vulnerable component version.

fromPackageUrl.title: From Package URL
fromPackageUrl.description: The purl of the component version being remediated (the vulnerable version)

recommendedPackageUrl.title: Recommended Package URL
recommendedPackageUrl.description: The purl of the recommended safe version to upgrade to

recommendedVersion.title: Recommended Version
recommendedVersion.description: The version Sonatype Guide recommends upgrading to

remediationType.title: Remediation Type
remediationType.description: The type of remediation recommendation from Sonatype Guide

reasons.title: Reason(s)
reasons.description: Sonatype Guide's explanation for why this version is recommended

recommendedVulnCount.title: Vulns in Recommended Version
recommendedVulnCount.description: Number of open security issues in the recommended version (should be 0 or near 0)

guideRemediationUrl.title: Guide Remediation URL
guideRemediationUrl.description: Link to the recommended component version on Sonatype Guide

fetchedAt.title: Fetched At
fetchedAt.description: When this remediation recommendation was last retrieved from Sonatype Guide

sourceVersion.title: Vulnerable Version
sourceVersion.description: The package version this remediation applies to
